subject: physics
content: A carrier wave with amplitude of 250 V is amplitude modulated by a sinusoidal base band signal of amplitude 150V. The ratio of minimum amplitude to maximum amplitude for the amplitude modulated wave is 50 : x, then value of x is ____________.
